risks: Blue Point is a multiyear capital project with construction, carbon-sequestration, offtake and policy execution risk before expected 2029 production.

Blue Point depends on multiyear construction, CCS infrastructure, partner performance and policy/economic support through 2029 startup.
Low-carbon ammonia competes with conventional ammonia and potentially green-electrolysis routes; relative gas, power and carbon economics can change the preferred pathway.
Nitrogen pricing and earnings remain sensitive to global outages, conflict, trade flows and natural-gas cost differentials.
Yazoo City outage reduces product availability until expected first-half 2027 restart and illustrates concentrated asset-operability risk.
Low-carbon project returns depend on construction discipline, CCS availability, tax-credit/policy durability and contracted/market offtake economics.

Industry-wide price/volume divergence means CF's strong pricing cannot by itself establish broad end-demand strength; delayed farmer purchases, outages and trade/energy disruptions can temporarily support price while suppressing volumes.
